title: attempt_complete postMessage payload
description: Canonical shape of the attempt_complete message sent from a game iframe to its parent harness. Fires AFTER recordAttempt(...) for the terminal answer and BEFORE the post-submit SFX/TTS chain, so the host can preload the next worksheet item before game_complete arrives. Payload shape is structurally identical to game_complete (data.metrics fields are field-by-field equal except for time/completedAt, which are timestamped at this message's own firing instant). See parts/PART-008.md § attempt_complete and schemas/postmessage-schema.md § attempt_complete.

data.description: Mirrors game_complete.data — see alfred/game-complete#/properties/data. Use the same buildEndPayload(correct) helper for both messages so they cannot drift.

completedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds at the instant attempt_complete fired. Will be earlier than game_complete.data.completedAt by however long the post-submit SFX + TTS chain takes (~1.5–3 s typical).
